infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: The app uses your contacts so the AI can help you call people by name.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: The app uses your calendar so the AI can help you review and schedule events.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app uses the camera so the AI can help with photos, OCR, and scene understanding.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: The app uses your photo library so the AI can help you understand and organize photos.
